description: Return the contents of one free file so you can read or modify the geometry directly: STEP and DXF as UTF-8 text, STL as base64; units are millimetres. Use it after get_free_files gives you the file name; use get_free_files instead when a download URL is enough. Files over 600 KB are not inlined: you get size_bytes and the URL. An unknown file name returns an error listing the valid names.

file.description: A file name exactly as get_free_files lists it, e.g. '4080-100'.

format.description: Default step. DXF exists only for 2D sections such as extrusion profiles.

object.description: Slug as returned by find_geometry or find_by_dimensions, e.g. '4080-aluminum-extrusion'. An exact name or alias also resolves.

name: get_file_content
title: Read one CAD file's contents
